snippets.TITLE: Balloons
snippets.WELCOME: Move the fan with your mouse under the red balloon so you can move it in the right direction. The aim of the game is to touch as many stars as possible. For each star you touch you will receive between 5 and 25 points. Beware of obstacles like birds, butterflies and bats. If you touch a bird, your ballon will explode. Good luck and enjoy!
